howItWorks.title: Why Sport Hub
howItWorks.subtitle: Four commitments so you find the right spot, fast.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Padel, surf, yoga, fitness, football, pétanque… No more juggling 12 apps and directories. Everything aggregated and deduplicated, here.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Spots come from official public databases (OpenStreetMap, French Ministry of Sports RES, Wikidata). A court exists? It's in. It closed? You can fix it.
howItWorks.step3Desc: No ads, no signup, no hidden commissions. You search, you find, you play — without being resold along the way.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything we get asked the most.
faq.a1: Yes, completely and ad-free. The data comes from open sources (OpenStreetMap, RES France, Wikidata, Overture Maps) and browsing is free. No signup, no paywall.
faq.q2: Where do the ~250,000 spots come from?
faq.a2: From cross-referencing four public sources: OpenStreetMap (ODbL), the French Ministry of Sports RES (Etalab), Wikidata (CC0) and Overture Maps. The same spot seen by several sources is automatically deduplicated (50 m + normalized name).
faq.q3: How do I add my club or spot?
faq.a3: Three options: (1) fill in our form (1 min, we add it within the week); (2) edit directly on OpenStreetMap — the change arrives here within 24h; (3) email us at hello@sporthubmap.com.
faq.q4: How do I book a class or find a coach?
faq.a4: Sport Hub does not handle bookings directly. Depending on the sport we point you to the right partner: Anybuddy (tennis/padel), ClassPass and Mindbody (fitness/yoga), Superprof (personal coaches), etc.
faq.q5: Is the data up to date?
faq.a5: Sources refresh automatically: OSM near real-time, RES France monthly, Overture quarterly. Google ratings are fetched on demand with a 30-day cache.
faq.q6: What families will be added next?
faq.a6: Short term: athletics (tracks, stadiums), climbing (gyms + crags), golf. Longer term: equestrian, winter sports, motorsports.
faq.q7: I'm a dev — is there an API?
faq.a7: Not yet publicly. The project is open (see OSM Overpass for ad-hoc queries) and a REST / vector tiles API is on the roadmap. Contact: hello@sporthubmap.com.
faq.a8: Yes. Coverage is global via OpenStreetMap and Overture. Density is highest in France (where we cross RES + OSM), but we index spots in 200+ countries.
